title: hepetis nuda
intro: Hepetis nuda, commonly known as Naked Herb or Chinese Chrysanthemum, is a flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and alleviate symptoms of fever and headache. The therapeutic actions of Hepetis nuda include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents of Hepetis nuda include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
